principle: Free to view is not the same as safe to redistribute. Explicit guards override optimistic source-stage labels.

KRX.reason: KRX OPEN API received information is kept out of the public repository pending explicit redistribution rights.

GLOBAL_VENDOR.reason: Commercial market prices and security quotes require a licensed redistribution source.

ICE_LICENSED.reason: ICE benchmark/index data require licensing review before redistribution.

LBMA.reason: LBMA precious-metal benchmark data are not treated as freely redistributable raw benchmark values.

LME.reason: LME delayed/benchmark market data require redistribution-rights review.

FUTURES_VENDOR.reason: Exchange futures settlements require an exchange/vendor redistribution license unless a public-domain alternative is verified.

KOFIA.reason: Official KOFIA automated access requires endpoint/approval or a clearly reusable public export.

KSD_KOFR.reason: KSD SEIBro OpenAPI access requires a service key/application; no no-key official machine endpoint has been verified.

gl_fi_sofr.reason: NY Fed reference-rate API works, but SOFR presentation requirements must be implemented in the frontend before public display.

gl_fi_effr.reason: NY Fed reference-rate API works, but EFFR presentation requirements must be implemented in the frontend before public display.
